phrases.label: this <element>
phrases.fix: say where the element sits, for example the URL below or the snippet below, or name the element outright

phrases.label: this <collection>
phrases.fix: say where the collection sits, for example the table above or the list below, or name what it contains

phrases.label: these <plural>
phrases.fix: count them and say where they sit, for example the three cases below, or name them outright

phrases.label: like this
phrases.fix: name what follows instead, for example with the following text or in the format below

phrases.label: in this order
phrases.fix: say where the order is written, for example in the order below or in the order the table above lists
